title: What Did I Come In This Room For
style: slow blues, 72 BPM, dirty electric guitar with bends, wailing harmonica, brushed snare, walking upright bass, hammond organ, world-weary male vocal, mournful comedic delivery, 12 bar blues structure
lyrics:
[Intro — slow blues guitar bend, harmonica wail, brushed snare]
I walked in the kitchen
With a purpose in mind…

[Verse 1]
I had it on the couch, I had it in the hall
Crystal clear intention, I was answering the call
Stood up with conviction, took the eight steps in
Now I'm standing in the kitchen with a spatula and a grin

[Pre-Chorus]
Was it the freezer? Was it the bin?
Was it a cup of tea I was meant to begin?
Was it a thought I had at three?
Was it something my partner just said to me?

[Chorus]
What did I come in this room for?
The room won't tell me why I'm at the door
What did I come in this room for?
I'll go back to where I was before
And the answer will hit me like a meteor
What did I come in this room for?

[Verse 2]
The doorway is the killer, the threshold is the thief
It steals your short-term memory, it brings the brain to grief
Scientists have studied it, they call it event boundary
You forget why you came in once you cross the foundry

[Pre-Chorus]
Was it the laundry? Was it the cat?
Was it the keys I was looking at?
Was it a charger? Was it a snack?
Was it something I never even put in the rack?

[Chorus]
What did I come in this room for?
The room won't tell me why I'm at the door
What did I come in this room for?
I'll go back to where I was before
And the answer will hit me like a meteor
What did I come in this room for?

[Bridge — guitar solo, mournful]
[spoken] …
…the spatula. I came for the spatula.
…why did I want the spatula?
…I have no idea.
…I'll come back tomorrow.

[Outro — slow fade]
What did I come in this room for?
The doorway took it from me once more
What did I come in this room for?
